title: Unit Event — Star of Your Own Story — Episode5 Life Is A Story

meta.Event Outline: Wonderlands×Showtime have decided to work with other troupes, starting with the long-established Shunmeiza. Given a minor role with just three lines, Tsukasa faces a seemingly impossible task: to convince the director that his character is a real person.

rows.Line: Shunmeiza - Studio

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: ...I know...but...

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line:
Bakuno.
We need to close up for the night soon.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
Oh...!
I'm sorry for staying so late.
I got so caught up reading the script that...

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line:
That's okay.
I know how passionate you are.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: Have you replied to them yet about starring in that short film?

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
Oh...
You were involved in the casting process, right, Mr. Kato...?

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line:
Yes, per the director's request.
He tasked me with getting you to accept.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
I really appreciate the offer.
It's an honor for someone like me to be offered the lead.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: But I still feel that...

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: I want to shine a light on them. The characters that deserve more attention.
bgm_area00004
Two weeks later
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Ready, everyone?!
Don't look away!!

rows.Speaker: Miku, Rin & Len
rows.Line: Ready!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then, begin.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “How long does that novelist plan on staying after ordering just one cup of coffee?”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
“Oh!
Is that man sitting in the corner writing a novel? That's so wonderful!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“Wonderful?
What's so great about dreaming away at a desk day in and day out?”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “And all he's doing is writing some made-up nonsense. Life is this, society is that... It's no use to anyone.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
“That's not true!
The words he chooses to carefully string together will benefit society!”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (It's been two weeks.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (We looked at several pieces of literature and went to that museum with a collection of items from the Showa period, all in order to gain a better understanding of the era and our characters.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Which seems to have been a boon for Emu and Nene.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Though, their roles already fit their personalities rather well. Chiyo's the dreamer, while Yuriko's the realist.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (And they've clearly figured out their characters' voices and behaviors, which were their tasks.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (That just leaves...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I heard the other day about the task Tsukasa was given.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I suppose we should expect no less from a professional director. He immediately saw Tsukasa's weakness.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (So, how well is he going to prepare for this role on so little information...?)
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa, how are you doing?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, Rui.
You and the others seem to be doing well.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: While I... I'm honestly having a lot of trouble.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I gave Nakayama some more thought after we last spoke, and I felt that imagining a profile of him would help me play him better. However...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I haven't been able to convince myself.
And Mr. Kato keeps saying, “You can still do better”...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Then, would you mind telling me about your current profile of him?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Sure.
Nakayama works as an editor for the literary magazine Shiranami... And I believe he's in his thirties.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: His lines are much more informal compared to Hino's, which makes me think that he's sort of a happy-go-lucky fellow.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I see.
I feel that you have the right idea.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Maybe. After coming up with that, I felt a little more confident and tried reciting his lines a few times...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But I still feel as if I'm missing something.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What if he's older than I think?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But if he were, I feel that he wouldn't seem so carefree next to Hino... Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (He's really stuck...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I wish I could say something to help...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But Tsukasa's trying to figure out his character by emulating what Bakuno does.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Me saying something will likely just confuse him even more. So...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I should just let him work for now.)
The next day
Tsukasa's Room

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I was hoping to think about my character more today since we don't have practice...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But I've hit a wall already...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I'm thinking about Nakayama as best I can based on my past experiences.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (However... No matter how hard I try, I'm still struggling to make my character feel like a real, fleshed-out person the way Bakuno does...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Why is that...?
What am I missing...?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No, stop...!
I'm not about to turn this place into a room of sighs!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, isn't there a new cafe at the park where I usually go running?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let's go get some fresh air!
Park Cafe

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh...
Not only is the weather very nice today, so is this cafe.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, I'll look for a seat out on the terrace and... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(That man looks suspicious...
He's eyeing everyone who passes by and hastily scrawling down something in his notebook...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Depending on what he does next, I may need to call the police... Still, he looks familiar for some reason...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
...!
Bakuno, is that you?!

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Oh...! Tenma!

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Wh-What a coincidence...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I was figuring out my character and decided to take a little break.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Also... Excuse me for asking, but what were you doing just now?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It seemed like you were writing something in your notebook...

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, um... This is just a hobby of mine... I-It's a strange one, and I am a little embarrassed by it...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
A hobby?
What kind?

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Uhh... I watch people...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, your hobby is people-watching!
To play your characters better, yes?!

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
No, um...! It's not like that!
This really is just a hobby...

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: A-Anyway, if you'll excuse me...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Please, wait!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Would it be okay if I saw your notebook?!

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
What...? Wh-What?!
Wh-Why?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I've actually been having a lot of trouble figuring my character out and, I'm in desperate need of a clue right now!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I also want to make my character feel more real like the way you do with yours, Bakuno!

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Th-These really aren't notes for acting or playing characters better...

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: B-But maybe just for a little bit...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Really?!
Thank you very much!!

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: I would really appreciate it if you didn't tell anyone about what I've written... Here.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (This notebook's been written in extensively... And almost every page is full...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (“Male. Sixties. Gentlemanly attire. Graceful gait. Seems relaxed, but looks around with a serious expression from time to time. Looking for someone?”)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (“But who? His expressions suggests that the person he's looking for is important to him. Family? An old friend? Or someone whose help he needs for those people? What if it's just his lost dog?”)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (“Maybe he's been searching for his wife ever since she suddenly disappeared one day decades ago. They could've met forty years ago when...”)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: These look like...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (“Female. Forties. Pallid face. Health problems? Stress at work? Based on attire, appears to have high-pressure position at large corporation.”)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (“Would stress alone cause someone to look so sick? She may be thinking about a mysterious phone call that came late at night...”)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I can't believe it...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Are you watching passersby and creating stories about them?

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
S-Stories...?!
No, that's going too far.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
They're just...
My imagination... What kinds of lives I think these people have led.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You imagine...the lives they've led...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Hang on a second.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (What he does may actually be similar to what I did with Thorpe and Rio.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(But therein lies a big difference.
I gleaned their worlds and emotions out of whatever lines were in those scripts.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Bakuno, on the other hand, is constructing entire stories about people's lives out of just tidbits of information.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Which means the reason he's able to make his characters feel so real is because his mind is used to doing that on a daily basis.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Yes, which means...!
I just have to come up with a story in the same way!)

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: U-Um... Can I have it back now...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, my apologies! And thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
No, I'm just glad I could help...
Although, I'm still not sure how much it will...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, this was huge!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Also, Bakuno, can you tell me exactly how people-watching became your hobby?

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Oh, um... I know what I do is very strange.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: To be perfectly honest, I never intended for it to become my hobby. It's always been this sort of habit of mine...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A habit?

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
Yes. I think...
Elementary school was when it all started...

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: For a number of reasons... I really needed someone to talk to.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh?
